g.text: Autonomy with boundaries, checkpoints and recovery
The Hermes loop keeps long-running agent work moving: failures trigger recovery, not dead ends.
1 · Understand the goal and plan the work with checkpoints
2 · Execute each step with the right agents and tools
3 · The checks pass, so the run proceeds
4 · A check fails: retry with backoff, roll back or try another path
5 · Recovery re-enters execution with what was learned
6 · Learn from the outcome and plan the next iteration
7 · Every step runs inside permission scopes, allowlists and approval gates
